entry.char: The slender adult female elf gravekeeper Rica keeps the exact same right-facing three-quarter planted ready stance with softly bent knees. She has silver-white hair with ONE thick braid draped on SCREEN RIGHT, long pointed ears, pale skin and calm ice-blue eyes. She wears a charcoal hood-down long cloak, a dark teal high-neck long-sleeved dress, a long tan canvas work apron with one flat pocket and repair stitches, a brown belt and pouch, cemetery keys, brown fingerless gloves, black stockings and brown cuffed work boots. She holds ONE ordinary gravedigger shovel diagonally across her body: the rear hand at screen left grips near its D handle beside her hip, and the forward hand at screen right supports the middle of the wooden shaft from underneath, with one thumb opposed to four fingers. The pointed metal spade stays low in front toward screen right.
entry.motion: Like a patient fighting game character waiting in guard, she repeats a steady measured rhythmic springy breathing cycle in place: her knees clearly flex and straighten within a shallow ready stance, her hips and torso sink and recover together, and her shoulders and both supported forearms rise and settle as one connected body. She keeps the same lightly forward ready lean, a level chin and quiet focused gaze toward the opponent. Her head and neck naturally follow her torso without nodding. Both hands maintain their exact grips and spacing, and the supported shovel moves with her arms as one rigid object, never swung independently. Repeat the same restrained ready-guard cycle several times, never lowering into a deep squat or changing stance.
entry.sway: Her single silver braid on screen right, short hair tips, charcoal cloak and long apron and dress hems softly follow through after the body and settle each cycle. The shovel D handle, straight wooden shaft, metal socket, central blade rib and pointed tip remain rigid and collinear, with constant shape, length and blade size. Fingers stay attached and wrapped around the handle, and the braid stays on screen right. No digging, no attack, no shovel flourish, no ghosts, no floating souls, no magic, no smoke, no particles, no glow.
